text: “如果放了他，他就会带着族人回来。”伯纳德说得或许没错。但你是远征队领队，必须为自己对待其他文化的行为负责。
你解开小人的束缚，退到一旁。他出乎意料地敏捷，转眼便冲进树林。你催促队伍朝相反方向前进。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 300
text: “If we release him, he’ll return with his people.” Bernard may be right. But you are the expedition leader and will be held responsible for your actions toward other cultures.
You unbind the little man and stand back. With surprising speed, he dashes away through the trees. You urge your party in the opposite direction.
